description: Returns the comment threads people or agents left on an ODocs.co document. Each thread has an id, the quoted text it refers to, whether it is resolved, and its replies. The default result is a readable plaintext <comment> list after a frontmatter (id, commentCount, openCommentCount, note); format:"json" returns the structured array, which also carries contextBefore / contextAfter around the quote, approximateLineNumber, anchored (true when that line is where the comment is attached, false when it is only where the quote text first appears), anchorState ("attached" or "detached": the text was changed or removed; anchored and orphaned mirror it), currentText (when attached, the text the comment sits on now, which can differ from the original quote) and occurrence (with the quote as find/anchor in patch-document it matches the commented copy; null if unknown). The text tags carry the same with placement="anchor" (plus occurrence) or "text", and state="detached" for a detached thread. The note (that comments are written by anyone with the link) is the frontmatter's note field in the text view; a json result carries it as a second text item.

format.description: Response format: 'text' (default) is a readable .txt-style view; 'json' is the structured object.

includeResolved.description: Include resolved threads too (default true); false returns open threads only.

name: list-comments
title: List Comments
